fullPassage: In an experiment conducted by researchers at the University of California, Los Angeles, study subjects were required to give a series of unplanned speeches in front of an audience (a reliable way to trigger anxiety). Half of the participants were then asked to engage in what the researchers call "affect labeling," filling in responses to the prompt "I feel ______," while the other half were asked to complete a neutral shape-matching task. The affect-labeling group showed steep declines in heart rate and skin conductance compared to the control group, whose levels of physiological arousal remained high. Brain-scanning studies offer further evidence of the calming effect of affect labeling: simply naming what is felt reduces activity in the amygdala, the brain structure involved in processing fear and other strong emotions. Meanwhile, thinking in a more involved way about feelings and the experiences that evoked them actually produces greater activity in the amygdala.

❌ ③ ample: ample(충분한)은 further와 유의어 방향
✅ ④ less: less(더 적은)는 further(추가적인)의 반의어 ←정답
det.tip: further evidence(추가적인 증거) ↔ less evidence(더 적은 증거)

questions.passage:
(A) The amygdala is the brain structure <u>involved</u> in processing fear and other strong emotions. It plays a crucial role in our emotional responses.

(B) Thinking in a more <u>involved</u> way about feelings actually produces greater activity in the amygdala. Simple labeling, on the other hand, reduces such activity.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 involved의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) involved = 관련된 (공포 처리에 관련된 뇌 구조). (B) involved = 복잡한 (감정에 대해 더 복잡한 방식으로 생각하는 것)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 참여하는 — (B) 참여하는: (A)의 involved는 participate가 아닌 'be involved in = ~에 관련된'
❌ ② (A) 관련된 — (B) 관련된: (B)의 'a more involved way'는 '더 복잡한/깊이 있는 방식'이지 '관련된 방식'이 아님
❌ ③ (A) 참여하는 — (B) 관련된: (A)는 '관련된', (B)는 '복잡한'
✅ ④ (A) 관련된 — (B) 복잡한: (A) 공포 처리에 '관련된' 뇌 구조, (B) 감정에 대해 '더 복잡한 방식으로' 생각하기 ←정답
det.tip: involved: (be involved in) ~에 관련된/참여하는 vs (a more involved way) 더 복잡한/깊이 있는

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a feeling of worry or uneasiness, typically about something with an uncertain outcome"

det.korean: anxiety=불안 (불확실한 결과에 대한 걱정이나 불안함의 감정)
det.analysis:
❌ ① arousal: arousal(각성)은 흥분/자극 상태이지 걱정이나 불안함이 아님
❌ ② conductance: conductance(전도도)는 물리적 측정 용어
✅ ③ anxiety: anxiety(불안)는 '불확실한 결과에 대한 걱정이나 불안함의 감정'이라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ labeling: labeling(명명)은 이름을 붙이는 행위
det.tip: anxiety = worry + uneasiness about uncertain outcomes

questions.passage: Brain-scanning studies offer further evidence of the __________ (calm) effect of affect labeling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: calm → calming: 명사 effect를 수식하는 현재분사형 형용사 필요
det.analysis: the __________ effect 구조에서 명사 effect 앞에 수식어가 필요. calm(형용사/동사) → calming(현재분사형 형용사)으로 변환. '진정시키는 효과'
det.tip: the calming effect — calm(동사) → calming(현재분사형 형용사). ~하는 효과

questions.passage: Simply naming what is felt reduces activity in the amygdala, the brain structure __________ (involve) in processing fear and other strong emotions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: involve → involved: 과거분사가 brain structure를 후치 수식. '관여하는 뇌 구조'
det.analysis: the brain structure __________ in processing 구조에서 과거분사(involved)가 명사를 후치 수식. involve(동사) → involved(과거분사). '처리에 관여하는 뇌 구조'
det.tip: the brain structure involved in — involve(관여시키다) → involved(관여하는). 과거분사의 후치수식

questions.passage: In an experiment conducted by researchers at the University of California, Los Angeles, study subjects were required to give a series of unplanned speeches in front of an audience (a reliable way to trigger anxiety). Half of the participants were then asked to engage in what the researchers call "affect labeling," filling in responses to the prompt "I feel ______," while the other half were asked to complete a neutral shape-matching task. The affect-labeling group showed steep declines in heart rate and skin conductance compared to the control group, whose levels of physiological arousal remained high. Brain-scanning studies offer further evidence of __________: simply naming what is felt reduces activity in the amygdala, the brain structure involved in processing fear and other strong emotions. Meanwhile, thinking in a more involved way about feelings and the experiences that evoked them actually produces greater activity in the amygdala.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 뇌 스캔 연구가 추가 증거를 제공하는 대상 = 감정 명명의 진정 효과
det.analysis:
❌ ① unplanned speeches in front of an audience: 즉흥 연설은 불안 유발 실험 도구이지 뇌 스캔의 증거 대상 아님
❌ ② a neutral shape-matching task: 통제 조건의 과제이지 증거 대상 아님
❌ ③ thinking in a more involved way about feelings: 깊이 생각하기는 편도체 활동 증가의 원인이지 진정 효과와 반대
✅ ④ the calming effect of affect labeling: 원문 일치. 뇌 스캔이 뒷받침하는 것 = '감정 명명의 진정 효과' ←정답
det.tip: Brain-scanning studies offer further evidence of ____ — 뇌 스캔 연구가 추가 증거를 제공하는 대상

the calming effect of affect labeling

det.analysis:
